title: No fault found — service and lubricate
likely_causes: Intermittent supply issue at the customer site
technician_checks: Bench test under load
Inspect internals for wear
Clean, lubricate and reassemble
solution: Full service: disassemble, clean, inspect, lubricate and test
quote_note: No fault was found on the bench; the tool was serviced, lubricated and tested.

title: Housing cracked or damaged
technician_checks: Inspect handle, inlet and housing joints for cracks
Check threads and screw holes
Inspect internal parts for impact damage
solution: Replace the housing or damaged section; check and replace damaged internal parts
quote_note: The housing is cracked and must be replaced; internal components will be checked for related damage.

title: Air leak at inlet
technician_checks: Soap-test the inlet with air connected
Inspect bushing threads and O-ring
Check the fitting and hose end
solution: Replace inlet bushing O-ring or the bushing; reseal or replace the fitting
quote_note: Air is leaking at the inlet; the inlet bushing and seal need replacement.

title: Trigger or throttle sticks / will not return
likely_causes: Worn throttle valve O-ring or seat
technician_checks: Cycle the trigger with air off and on
Remove the throttle valve; inspect seat, O-ring and spring
Check the trigger pivot pin and lever
solution: Clean or replace the throttle valve and O-ring; replace the trigger spring or lever as needed
quote_note: The throttle is sticking; the throttle valve assembly needs cleaning or replacement.

title: Runs but stalls or loses power under load
likely_causes: Low air pressure or volume (undersized hose, fittings)
Clogged inlet screen or exhaust muffler
Scored cylinder or worn end plates
technician_checks: Verify 90 psi at the tool under load with the correct hose size
Clean the inlet screen and muffler
Inspect rotor blades, cylinder and end plates
solution: Correct the air supply; clean inlet and exhaust; replace worn rotor blades and any scored motor parts
quote_note: The tool loses power under load; internal motor wear and restricted airflow will be corrected.

title: Seized or will not turn (corrosion)
likely_causes: Rust on rotor, cylinder or bearings
technician_checks: Try to rotate the motor by hand
Disassemble; inspect rotor, blades, cylinder and bearings for rust and pitting
Check the customer air supply for water
solution: Disassemble, clean and de-rust; replace rotor blades, bearings and any pitted parts; lubricate
quote_note: Internal corrosion has seized the tool; a teardown, cleaning and replacement of corroded parts is required.

title: Excessive vibration
technician_checks: Run without the accessory
Check bearing play at the spindle
Inspect rotor and shaft for runout
Check retaining nuts and screws
solution: Replace bearings and any damaged rotor or spindle; balance or replace the accessory
quote_note: Vibration is caused by worn bearings and/or a damaged spindle; these components require replacement.

title: Low torque / weak output
likely_causes: Air leak at inlet or motor housing
technician_checks: Check air supply and inlet screen
Measure free speed
Inspect rotor blades, hammer cage and anvil
solution: Replace rotor blade set; replace hammer cage and anvil if worn; clean and lubricate
quote_note: Impact mechanism and motor components are worn; the tool needs an internal rebuild to restore torque.

title: Will not run / no rotation
technician_checks: Check trigger and throttle valve
Turn the rotor by hand
Inspect motor for corrosion
solution: Free or replace the motor; replace rotor blades; service the throttle valve
quote_note: The motor is seized or the throttle valve is not passing air; internal repair required.

title: Runs but does not impact
technician_checks: Run under load and listen for hammer strike
Disassemble the hammer case; inspect hammers, pins, cage and anvil
Check the hammer case bearing
solution: Replace hammers, hammer pins and cage or frame as worn; replace anvil if lugs are rounded
quote_note: The impact mechanism is worn and no longer strikes; the hammer assembly requires replacement.

title: Anvil broken or drive square worn (socket will not hold)
likely_causes: Worn drive square or retaining ring groove
technician_checks: Inspect the anvil for cracks and rounded corners
Check the retaining ring and groove
Check anvil bushing play
solution: Replace the anvil and socket retainer; replace the anvil bushing if worn
quote_note: The anvil is damaged and will not hold sockets safely; anvil replacement is required.

title: Reverse does not work / runs one direction only
technician_checks: Cycle the reverse lever under air
Remove the reverse valve; inspect ports, O-rings and detent
Check for scoring in the valve bore
solution: Clean or replace the reverse valve and O-rings; replace the lever or detent as needed
quote_note: The forward/reverse valve is not switching correctly; the valve assembly needs service or replacement.

title: Ratchet slips or free-wheels under load
technician_checks: Load the drive square by hand in both directions
Disassemble the head; inspect yoke, pawl, spring and gear
Check the drive bushing for play
solution: Replace the yoke, drive bushing and pawl; replace the drive gear if teeth are worn
quote_note: The ratchet head mechanism is worn and slipping; head components require replacement.

title: Low power / slow
technician_checks: Check air supply and inlet screen
Inspect rotor blades, cylinder and bearings
Check the gear train for drag
solution: Replace rotor blades and motor bearings; replace the cylinder if scored
quote_note: The air motor is worn and down on power; motor components will be replaced.

title: Head loose, rattles or locks up
technician_checks: Check head bolt torque
Check play at the drive square
Disassemble and inspect crank, bushing and yoke
solution: Rebuild the head with new bushing and yoke; retorque head bolts; grease
quote_note: The ratchet head is loose or binding; a head rebuild is required.

title: Low speed or power
technician_checks: Check air supply and inlet screen
Measure free speed
Inspect rotor blades, cylinder and bearings
solution: Replace rotor blades and bearings; clean inlet and muffler
quote_note: The air motor is worn; motor components will be replaced to restore speed and power.

title: Chuck will not hold or bit runs out
technician_checks: Check runout with a straight bit
Inspect chuck jaws and key
Check spindle and bearing play
solution: Replace the chuck; replace spindle or bearings if runout remains
quote_note: The chuck is worn and will not hold bits true; chuck replacement is required.

title: Low speed or power
technician_checks: Check air supply and inlet screen
Measure free speed
Inspect blades, cylinder, end plates and bearings
solution: Replace rotor blades and bearings; replace cylinder or end plates if scored; clean muffler
quote_note: The air motor is worn and down on speed; motor components will be replaced.

title: Collet slips or bit runs out
likely_causes: Bent spindle or worn spindle bearing
technician_checks: Check runout with a straight shank
Inspect collet and nut
Check spindle bearing play
solution: Replace the collet and nut; replace spindle bearing or spindle if runout remains
quote_note: The collet is worn and will not hold accessories true; collet replacement is required.

title: Bearing noise or vibration
technician_checks: Run without an accessory and listen
Check bearing play at the spindle
Inspect rotor and shaft
solution: Replace motor bearings; replace the rotor if damaged
quote_note: Motor bearings have failed; bearing replacement is required.

title: Low power or stalls
technician_checks: Check air supply and inlet screen
Measure free speed
Inspect blades, cylinder and bearings
Check the bevel gears
solution: Replace rotor blades and bearings; clean inlet and muffler
quote_note: The air motor is worn; motor components will be replaced to restore power.

title: Gear noise or spindle play
technician_checks: Run and listen at the head
Check spindle play
Disassemble the head; inspect gears and bearings
solution: Replace the bevel gear set and spindle bearings; regrease
quote_note: The angle head gears and bearings are worn; head components require replacement.

title: Spindle lock or guard damaged
likely_causes: Broken spindle lock pin or button
technician_checks: Test the spindle lock
Inspect guard and clamp
solution: Replace the spindle lock and the guard or clamp
quote_note: Safety components (spindle lock/guard) are damaged and must be replaced before use.

title: Low speed or stalls
technician_checks: Check air supply and inlet screen
Measure free speed
Inspect rotor blades, cylinder and end plates
solution: Replace rotor blades; replace scored cylinder or end plates; clean exhaust
quote_note: The air motor is worn and slow; motor components will be replaced.

title: Pad wobble or heavy vibration
likely_causes: Damaged pad or loose pad screw
technician_checks: Run without the pad
Check spindle bearing play
Inspect balancer shaft and pad
solution: Replace the spindle bearing and balancer shaft as needed; replace the pad
quote_note: The pad drive is worn and vibrating; bearing and balancer components require replacement.

title: Weak blow / low impact
likely_causes: Low air pressure or restricted inlet
technician_checks: Check air supply and inlet screen
Disassemble; inspect piston, barrel bore and valve
Check for scoring
solution: Replace the piston and valve; replace the barrel if the bore is worn
quote_note: The hammer mechanism is worn and strikes weakly; piston and valve components require replacement.

title: Will not cycle / hammer
technician_checks: Check throttle valve operation
Remove the barrel; check piston movement
Inspect the valve and spring
solution: Free or replace the piston; replace the valve kit and spring; clean the barrel
quote_note: The hammer will not cycle; the piston and valve assembly require service or replacement.

title: Chisel will not stay in / retainer broken
technician_checks: Inspect the retainer and spring
Check the barrel nose bore
solution: Replace the chisel retainer; replace the barrel if the nose is worn
quote_note: The chisel retainer is damaged and unsafe; retainer replacement is required.

title: Weak or no needle action
technician_checks: Check air supply
Inspect piston, valve and barrel
Check needle holder movement
solution: Replace the piston and valve; replace needles; free the needle holder
quote_note: The scaler mechanism is worn; piston, valve and needles require replacement.

title: Needles bent, broken or falling out
technician_checks: Inspect needle set and holder
Check the front cap and guide
solution: Replace the needle set and holder as worn; secure the front cap
quote_note: The needle set and holder are worn; replacement is required.

title: External oil leak
likely_causes: Loose or damaged plugs and fittings
technician_checks: Clean the unit and find the exact leak path
Inspect ram, gland, reservoir, plugs and valve area
solution: Reseal the affected components; replace damaged plugs or fittings
quote_note: Leak found; affected hydraulic sealing components require repair or reseal.

title: Ram / cylinder seal bypass
technician_checks: Load-hold test
Inspect for drift
Teardown cylinder
Inspect ram, bore and seal lips
solution: Replace cylinder packing; polish or replace the ram if scored
quote_note: Internal cylinder sealing is bypassing or suspected to be bypassing under load.

title: Lifts but will not hold
likely_causes: Suction, delivery, release or bypass valve leakage
technician_checks: Check release valve seating
Load-hold test
Bleed
Inspect valve seats, balls and cylinder packing
solution: Reseal cylinder; lap or replace valve seats and balls; bleed the system
quote_note: Jack loses hydraulic pressure under load; internal leakage requires inspection.

title: Will not lift to full height
likely_causes: Bent ram or damaged lift arm
technician_checks: Check oil level with ram fully lowered
Bleed the system
Inspect ram and lift arm for damage
solution: Top up oil and bleed; replace the ram or lift arm if bent
quote_note: The jack is short on travel; the hydraulic system will be refilled, bled and checked for damage.

title: Handle pumps with no resistance
likely_causes: Check valve stuck or debris on the seat
technician_checks: Check oil level
Inspect pump piston and seals
Inspect check valve balls and seats
solution: Reseal the pump piston; clean or replace check valves; refill
quote_note: The pump is not building pressure; pump seals and check valves require replacement.

title: Will not lower or lowers too fast
technician_checks: Operate the release valve through its range
Inspect release valve, needle and seat
solution: Replace the release valve and seat
quote_note: The release valve is faulty; replacement is required for controlled lowering.

title: Air/hydraulic: air pump does not run
technician_checks: Check air supply and inlet
Test the air valve
Disassemble and inspect the air motor
solution: Rebuild or replace the air motor and air valve
quote_note: The air-operated pump is not running; the air motor requires rebuild or replacement.

title: Will not start
technician_checks: Test the cord and plug for continuity
Test the switch
Inspect brushes and brush holders
Test armature and field windings
solution: Replace the cord, switch or brushes as found; replace armature or field if open
quote_note: The tool is not powering on; the electrical fault has been located and the failed component will be replaced.

title: Sparks heavily or smells burnt
technician_checks: Inspect brushes and commutator
Test the armature for shorts
Check the field windings
solution: Replace brushes; replace the armature if the commutator or windings are damaged
quote_note: The motor is arcing and overheating; the armature and brushes require replacement.

title: Overheats or low power
technician_checks: Clear vents and fan
Check bearing drag
Test field and armature
Inspect brushes
solution: Clean the motor; replace bearings and brushes; replace field or armature if weak
quote_note: The motor is overheating and down on power; it will be cleaned and worn components replaced.

title: Power cord damaged
technician_checks: Inspect the full cord length and plug
Check the strain relief and terminal connections
solution: Replace the cord and strain relief
quote_note: The power cord is damaged and unsafe; cord replacement is required.

title: Load slips or will not hold
technician_checks: Load test: raise, hold, check for drift
Disassemble the brake; inspect discs, ratchet and pawl
Check for contamination
solution: Replace brake friction discs, ratchet disc and pawl spring; clean and reassemble the brake dry
quote_note: The load brake is worn and not holding safely; brake components require replacement.

title: Hard to operate / binds
likely_causes: Worn load sheave or chain guide
technician_checks: Inspect load chain for wear, stretch and twist
Check the load sheave and guide
Inspect gears and bearings
Operate unloaded
solution: Replace worn load chain, sheave or guide; replace damaged gears or bearings; lubricate
quote_note: The hoist binds because of chain and drive wear; worn components will be replaced.

title: Hook stretched, twisted or latch damaged
technician_checks: Measure hook throat opening against the limit
Inspect for twist and cracks
Check the latch and hook bearing
solution: Replace the hook assembly and safety latch
quote_note: The hook is damaged beyond safe limits; hook replacement is required.

title: Load chain worn, stretched or corroded
technician_checks: Measure chain pitch over several links
Inspect links for wear, cracks and corrosion
solution: Replace the load chain
quote_note: The load chain is worn beyond the safe limit; chain replacement is required.

title: Free-chains under load or will not hold
technician_checks: Load test: lift, hold, check for drift
Disassemble; inspect brake discs, pawls and ratchet
solution: Replace brake discs, pawls and springs; clean the brake
quote_note: The load brake is not holding safely; brake components require replacement.

title: Lever ratchet slips
technician_checks: Operate the lever in both directions
Inspect ratchet wheel, pawl and spring
solution: Replace the ratchet wheel, pawl and spring
quote_note: The lever ratchet is worn and slipping; ratchet components require replacement.

title: Chain, cable or hook damaged
technician_checks: Measure chain pitch or inspect cable strands
Measure hook throat opening; inspect latch
Check for kinks, nicks and corrosion
solution: Replace the load chain or cable and the hook assembly as needed
quote_note: The load chain, cable or hook is worn beyond the safe limit; replacement is required.

title: Weak or no retraction
technician_checks: Check tension adjustment
Inspect the spring and drum
Operate through full travel
solution: Replace the power spring; reset tension
quote_note: The main spring is fatigued or broken; spring replacement is required.

title: Cable frayed or broken
likely_causes: Cable wear at the drum or guide
technician_checks: Inspect the full cable length and end fittings
Check the cable guide
solution: Replace the cable assembly and cable guide
quote_note: The suspension cable is damaged and unsafe; cable replacement is required.

title: Drum lock not holding or stuck
technician_checks: Test the lock at several positions
Inspect pawl, spring and ratchet
solution: Replace the lock pawl and spring; replace the drum if the ratchet is damaged
quote_note: The drum lock is faulty; lock components require replacement.

title: No picture / black screen
technician_checks: Test the camera head on a known controller
Check continuity through the push rod
Inspect connectors for corrosion
solution: Replace the camera head, push rod or controller as found; clean connectors
quote_note: The system is not producing an image; the failed component has been identified for replacement.

title: Picture intermittent or flickers
likely_causes: Worn slip ring in the reel
technician_checks: Flex-test the push rod while watching the picture
Inspect connectors and slip ring
Test with a known head
solution: Repair or replace the push rod section; replace the slip ring or connector
quote_note: The video signal is intermittent; the damaged cable or connector requires repair.

title: Push rod kinked, cracked or broken
technician_checks: Inspect the full rod length
Measure the damaged section
Test continuity
solution: Cut back and re-terminate the rod, or replace the push rod
quote_note: The push rod is damaged; it will be cut back and re-terminated or replaced.

title: Camera lights not working
likely_causes: Light control fault at the controller
technician_checks: Test light control
Inspect the head for moisture
Test the LED board
solution: Replace the LED board; reseal the head
quote_note: The camera lighting has failed; the LED assembly requires replacement.

title: Distance counter not reading
technician_checks: Test the counter while feeding rod
Inspect the sensor and wheel
Check wiring
solution: Replace the counter sensor or wheel; repair wiring
quote_note: The distance counter is not reading; the counter assembly requires repair.

title: Water in the camera head
technician_checks: Inspect the lens window and seals
Check for moisture and corrosion inside the head
solution: Reseal or replace the camera head
quote_note: Water has entered the camera head; the head requires reseal or replacement.

title: Sonde / locator not transmitting
technician_checks: Test with a locator at the correct frequency
Check sonde wiring at the head
solution: Replace the sonde; repair wiring
quote_note: The locating sonde is not transmitting; sonde replacement is required.

title: Battery will not charge or runtime is short
technician_checks: Test the battery on a known charger
Test a known battery on the tool
Inspect contacts
solution: Replace the battery or charger; clean or replace contacts
quote_note: The battery no longer holds a charge; battery replacement is required.

title: Will not run with a good battery
technician_checks: Test with a known battery
Test the switch
Check the controller and motor
solution: Replace the switch, controller or motor as found
quote_note: The tool does not run; the failed electrical component will be replaced.

title: Runs briefly then stops
technician_checks: Test with a known battery
Check motor temperature and vents
Test the switch under load
solution: Replace the battery, switch or controller as found; clean cooling vents
quote_note: The tool cuts out under load; the failing component has been identified for replacement.
